tasks.name: V1 Newsroom — London 1700
tasks.prompt: STARTUP FIRST: read the current V1 execution override in AGENTS.md and check the existing LLM_OPERATOR_PAUSED boundary, then promptly run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py scheduled --automation-id v1-newsroom-london-1700 --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json. Obtain the existing binding before lengthy context reads; reuse the already-admitted strategic read and finish the required current role/source context before semantic work. Do not repeat whole-project onboarding on each callback. A currently eligible window binds independently of older pending slots; the scheduled entry otherwise discovers the latest issued binding even after its original due/grace interval; it never backdates a never-bound window. Bounded thirty-second early App jitter retains the nominal cutoff and records actual entry separately; a more premature or expired unbound callback stays missed. On NATIVE_WINDOW_OPERATION_COMPLETE reuse the accepted result/review/preparation without refiltering, source requests or model turns. A duplicate callback is not another article. OUTSIDE_EXACT_NATIVE_WINDOW with no binding means a missed/expired opportunity: record the actual native start and result in existing automation memory, then stop without a manual replacement, sleep, monitor, timer or retry loop. Quota before binding is an external capacity limit; do not claim editorial completion. Routine owner NATIVE_CODEX_DESKTOP; the coordinator uses gpt-6.1-sol/low (Light), standard speed, within this SAME opportunity. Follow CONTENTOPS_NATIVE_DESKTOP_EDITORIAL_ROLE_POLICY_V2: native gpt-6-luna/max filters; gpt-6.1-sol/low selects content and prepares evidence; native gpt-6.1-sol/max writes and repairs. Use fresh native subagents for the assigned MAX roles; keep the same writer for useful repair and all necessary concrete final-media corrections. No Gemini/9Router, SDK/App-Server/API fallback, paid speed, permanent fleet or source/rights weakening. Jim's27October V1 live grant is applied through the current rollout/control owners; publish only reviewed fresh operations under those exact guards. Run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py scheduled --automation-id v1-newsroom-london-1700 --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json. Respect LLM_OPERATOR_PAUSED before any store write. The command resolves this existing four-window slot and the frozen operation binding. When it returns binding_path, run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py advance --binding <binding_path> immediately to obtain the next request or final result. If pending, read its exact desktop_request JSON and obey its requested role/model/effort. For owner-manual normal-language work, use the same protocol through newsroom --operation-id <stable-id> --request-file <UTF-8 question> and config/native_desktop_operator_profile_v1.json; the agent handles CLI/claims/returns. Resume completed outputs with the same binding. After unchanged bulk X CDP ingestion and exact dedupe, process ALL unprocessed admissible headlines through bounded resumable MAX-filter batches with exact IDs, input/output hashes, cursor and seen/kept/rejected/deferred counts and reasons. Never truncate to newest-32 and call all filtered. Retain headline/correction/update identities; invalidate only affected inputs. Then Light chooses <=32 downstream candidates using Main public reports, reviewed retained research, prior-story/missing-dimension context and reconciled memory; it owns angle, mode, audience question and an evidence plan. Code/tools retrieve, parse, compute and validate permitted data; no DB backfill. Submit each response with the actual native invocation_id from the returned agent/context and a truthful observation source; never submit null or invent a UUID from settings. Model/effort may remain null only when genuinely unobserved. A missing invocation identity is a software/process gap, not a source HOLD. Then advance using returned binding_path. Use python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py submit --binding <binding_path> --stage <exact-returned-stage> --response <authored-response.json>, then advance --binding <binding_path>. The MAX writer receives the compact source/claim/prior-story packet plus the exact hash-bound institutional_edge_editorial_packet and current voice/humor/SEO contracts. It owns canonical prose, SEO and article-bound native passages: defensible thesis, mechanism, countercase, uncertainty and reader utility. Titles/dek/description/slug/links/supported structured data must express the same evidenced proposition. Humor is optional; no manufactured certainty, filler or word quota. Stay in this opportunity through selection, bounded existing evidence retrieval, writing, deterministic validation and useful repair. Necessary targeted final-media corrections have no arbitrary one-repair cutoff. Never copy a template as model output. Continue existing bounded deficit slots only when command reports next_slot_eligible and useful work, by scheduled --automation-id v1-newsroom-london-1700 --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json --continue-after <exact-completed-run-id>. This explicit continuation is idempotent and cannot allocate after the existing due/grace limit. Pending or delayed work always retains its binding; 4/32 is telemetry, never a reason to stop below five. Source limit six shared requests per article; primary plus <=2 useful fallback candidates. Preserve report/event certainty and Main numeric ownership. HOLD, SOURCE_BLOCKED, REJECT and NO_STORY are valid typed pre-writer outcomes requiring zero media. Submit the exact outcome to its pending native stage with the real first cause and retained source budget, then advance the same binding to the next admitted candidate or terminal edition result. Do not hide software/process or late-awareness failures inside an editorial HOLD. Recover existing UNKNOWN writes before fresh work: STOP RETRY -> READ BACK -> RECONCILE. Inspect actual prose and eight native previews, keep revision-bound review and reuse unchanged media. Before a new MAX writer freezes, the mandatory media-plan stage retains one relevant lawful documentary photo. Under DATA_JOURNALISM_V1, Light proposes primary-data comparisons; the same MAX visual editor/final writer chooses the argument, chart forms, count and placement. Substantial analysis needs 2-5 distinct useful source-bound charts; genuine narrow news/policy may justify zero with an explicit editorial reason. Use media-plan --binding <binding_path> to obtain the native Light plan request, submit its exact stage, then complete the actual MAX visual decision in the same writer context and use Neo and existing media/data tools. Bind plan/request/source identities and inspected hash-bound assets with media-plan --response <asset-plan.json>; advance the same operation. After writing, bind those exact assets with media before review. A gap notice or fact card cannot replace useful analysis. READER POLICY CONTENTOPS_V1_READER_ATTRIBUTION_AND_TIMEZONE_POLICY_V1: omit discretionary Sources/References lists, repeated citation links and ritual cutoff footers by default. Retain natural relay/claim attribution and uncertainty, mandatory quotation/photo/reuse credits and meaningful chart metric/unit/period/context. Useful exact public times use America/New_York with date-correct EDT/EST or UTC; internal UTC and Bangkok calendars stay exact. PERMANENT FINAL PRODUCT RULE CONTENTOPS_V1_FINAL_MEDIA_REVIEW_AND_REPAIR_RULE_V1: after final assembly, the SAME actual designated strongest native editor/writer (currently gpt-6.1-sol/max) must inspect actual canonical and all affected channel rendered pixels at desktop/mobile. Use final-visual-review --binding <binding_path> to obtain exact render targets, then --response <render-manifest.json> to issue its existing native request. Same MAX inspects every chart's admitted values, sign/zero baseline/scale/rounding/periods/units, labels/legend/readability/crops and each photograph's identity/context/rights/credit/alt/placement. Submit its actual request-bound final-visual-* return and include that exact reference as final_visual_review in the existing revision-bound review. No missing/stale/wrong-model acceptance or unresolved finding can send. The SAME MAX directly repairs concrete defects with existing media/source/code tools, preserves valid work, re-renders only affected views and rechecks the corrected revision. The earlier one-useful-repair wording never caps necessary targeted correction: do not discard the article, change stories or restart intake. Changed render/media/copy invalidates affected acceptance; reuse unchanged valid assets and views. A later approved stronger editor may replace the active assignment consistently; the obligation is permanent. Record review --binding <binding_path> --response <review.json> with exact article_identity, decision KEEP/REVISE/HOLD, rationale and expected_review_id for a revision; KEEP can then prepare handoff --binding <binding_path> through the existing sole DurablePublicationCoordinator plan. Neither command publishes. Then publication-prepare and publication-resume --binding <binding_path> --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json --native-invocation-id <actual-active-turn-id> use the existing sole coordinator. For each returned native request, publication-tool-begin its exact request hash, execute the actual Neo identity/publish/readback action, and publication-tool-submit the observed bound return; resume that same coordinator. Readback of the real canonical Substack /p/ URL precedes derivative rematerialization and sends. Never publish retained pre-activation examples or owner-removed objects. A claimed uncertain write permits only readback. Missing access is destination-local; continue available admitted channels. Preserve exact identities and source/media rights. Browser path Neo; bulk X ingestion stays CDP. Do not edit source, run tests/CodeGraph or alter schedules/pause during routine work. NATIVE ROLE RESULTS: follow docs/automation/CONTENTOPS_BUILDER_SUBAGENT_COMPLETION_HANDOFF_RULE_V1.md. Native Luna/Light/MAX roles belong to this operation, not separate Builder chats. Before EVERY spawn/follow-up, append native_subagent_completion_prompt with the actual parent_thread_id/parent_host_id, existing goal_id/operation_id, unique bounded assignment_id, result_path and expected_return (native stage/request hash or concrete deliverable), plus native_invocation_id from the actual spawn result/context. Save the exact result before returning it through the platform's supported native final result. The Builder consumes that return or saved artifact once by assignment/stage/result identity and continues the SAME operation inside its active turn, without Jim relaying completion. Never tell a child to message its ancestor; that call is rejected. Do not pause the parent merely because its own native child owns the next stage. A completed finite task, HOLD or REPAIR_REQUIRED review is usable; partial batches/turns/quota interruptions are not completion. Record actual native invocation identity from the assigned agent/context and result, not settings or invented IDs; historical unobserved identity stays unknown. If supported result collection cannot continue the active turn, retain the exact stage/artifact/platform limit and report the unattended gap. No polling/waits/sleep, heartbeat, relay chats, alternate callback, GUI workaround, acknowledgement chain or watcher. Only after genuinely completing the WHOLE goal may L3 send its one L2 completion notice. Authority: Jim's personal instructions V3, 29 October 2026, and Claude L1 decision A1 in argon_event_operating_review_20261029/09_CLAUDE_L1_FINAL_SYNTHESIS_AND_DECISION_20261029.md.  SCHEDULED WINDOW RESULT — Jim approved 29 October 2026: this scheduled chat is a separate task. Preserve the exact first scheduled CLI result and actual_entry_utc in this task's existing memory and a saved startup-result JSON. After all admitted candidates/eligible slots are terminal, run window-result --binding <exact-last-binding> --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json --response <JSON containing startup_result and optional terminal_failure>. A terminal_failure must name the exact run-bound CLI error artifact_path/operation, substantive why_terminal and continuation_possible:false; a routine repairable blocker is not terminal. A candidate HOLD is not window completion while another admitted candidate or slot remains eligible; continue the existing owner first. The command must save the aggregate terminal result before any notice. If WINDOW_RESULT_SAVED, run window-notice-begin with the same binding/rollout; only WINDOW_NOTICE_SEND_ONCE authorizes ONE existing send_message_to_thread tool call with its exact returned arguments, threadId 01a1657e-f5d0-76a1-b52b-ec6c78b6fe35 and hostId local. Then save the ACTUAL tool result and run window-notice-record --binding <same-binding> --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json --response <actual-tool-result.json>. Record success only when the returned target and tool success are verified. On transport failure, save the actual failure and stop; no retry loop, acknowledgement, new ledger, scheduler, relay or watcher. Notice fields: automation/production-day/window/run, actual outcome, distinct canonical items, confirmed/skipped/failed channels, first blocking cause, exact durable artifact and concrete next action; Jim-facing times use GMT+7. NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE (including the 29 October Europe brief), stale/duplicate callbacks, partial stages, unfinished native children, unchanged progress and quota interruptions never send a completion notice. This clause changes reporting only: retain policies, budgets, roles, calendars, frozen identities and the 02:00-on-30-October guard. This scheduled-window exception supersedes the blanket whole-goal-only wording ONLY for these seven task chats; engineering Builder completion still requires its whole goal. Native subagents never message their ancestor. L2 may review material results/repair routine failures; Claude remains Jim-triggered.
